source_text: Mittuntur ab Iesu exploratores in Hiericho et suscipiuntur a meretrice Raab. Possunt angeli Dei putari — Ecce mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam. Meretrices et publicani credentes baptizati sunt. Raab interpretatur latitudo — ecclesia Christi ex peccatoribus collecta. Angustus mihi est locus; dilata paxillos tuos. Susceptos in superioribus collocat; nemo ab Iesu missus deorsum iacet. Ex meretrice fit prophetes: Scio quia Dominus Deus vester tradidit vobis terram. De praeteritis confitetur, de praesentibus credit, de futuris prophetat. Iapheth quoque dilatatio — populus ex gentibus; Chanaan servus fit ut oboediendo salvetur.
pass_a_gloss: Are-sent by Jesus spies into Jericho and are-received by harlot Rahab. They-can angels of-God be-thought — Behold I-send angel my before face your. Harlots and tax-collectors believing baptized were. Rahab is-interpreted breadth — church of-Christ from sinners collected. Narrow to-me is place; widen pegs your. Received-ones in higher-places she-places; no-one by Jesus sent downward lies. From harlot she-becomes prophetess: I-know that Lord God your has-handed to-you land. Concerning past-things she-confesses, concerning present-things she-believes, concerning future-things she-prophesies. Japheth also enlargement — people from nations; Canaan servant becomes that by-obeying he-may-be-saved.
pass_b_english: Jesus sends spies into Jericho; they are received by the harlot Rahab. They may be read as [[angels God sends before his face to prepare his way >> Bible:Matthew 11:10]]. [[Harlots and tax collectors believed and were baptized >> Bible:Matthew 21:32]]. Rahab means “breadth” — Christ’s church gathered from sinners. She says: [[The place is too narrow for me; enlarge your cords >> Bible:Isaiah 49:20; 54:2]]. She lodges the spies upstairs; no one sent by Jesus lies low on the ground. From harlot she becomes prophetess: [[I know the Lord your God has given you this land >> Bible:Joshua 2:9]]. She confesses the past, believes the present, prophesies the future. Japheth too means enlargement — the people saved from the nations; Canaan is made a servant so that by obedience he may find salvation.
